cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.
